gaps: NODE_ENV must be production for the public build.
Public hosting requires the signed invite access profile.
PRESENT_ACCESS_ORIGIN must be the exact public HTTPS origin.
A stable high-entropy access secret of at least 32 characters is required; presence/length do not verify entropy.
Both native data and access directories must be explicit absolute private durable paths.
Native data and access records must both be covered by the inspected absolute persistent mount.
Target must serve the exact requested revision; another healthy revision does not count.
Supply a legitimate VITE_TLDRAW_LICENSE_KEY at build time, then rebuild the frontend. NEXT_PUBLIC_TLDRAW_LICENSE_KEY alone is not the declared native Docker build argument.
Verify the built frontend has an active tldraw license valid for the actual public host and appropriate use. Key presence is not license validity; public browser editor acceptance remains required.
A separately authorized real planning and workspace run must verify generation, workspace profile, commands and canonical artifact publication; catalog reads do not prove execution.
